en.title: Validating Magical Binary Strings with RegEx
en.description:
Determine whether a binary string starts with 1, contains at least two 0s, and has an even total number of 0s.

The standard input/output format and any supplementary ranges on this site are as stated in this problem.
en.input: The first line contains q (1≤q≤1000), followed by q lines, each a binary string of length 1..1000.
en.output: For each string, output True or False on its own line.
en.explanation: Check the first character and the number of 0s; the string qualifies when there are at least two and the count is even.
hints: Check the first character and the number of 0s; the string qualifies when there are at least two and the count is even.
